title: CRISPR RNP Electroporation Protocol
author: Aditya Mohan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8yfhxtn

steps.title: Subculture cells and inspect health
steps.instruction: Subculture the cells for a minimum of 2–3 days before electroporation and examine them under a microscope to confirm a healthy appearance.

steps.title: Prepare prewarmed culture plates
steps.instruction: Prepare a 96‑well U‑bottom plate with at least 175 µL of culture medium per well and a 24‑well plate with at least 1 mL of medium per well; prewarm both plates to 37 °C.

steps.title: Assemble guide RNA‑Cas9 RNP mix

steps.title: Incubate RNP mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the assembled RNP mixture for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare electroporation enhancer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the Alt‑R Cas9 Electroporation Enhancer in IDTE to a final concentration of 100 µM.

steps.title: Prepare sgRNA oligo stock
steps.instruction: Resuspend sgRNA oligos in IDTE to 100 µM. For a 2 nmol IDT order, dilute the oligos with 20 µL Tris‑HCl (Dharmacon).

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Collect 1 × 10⁶ cells per electroporation, wash the cells with PBS, then centrifuge at 30 g for 10 minutes at room temperature. Remove as much supernatant as possible without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend cells with electroporation reagents
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 96 µL Ingenio® Electroporation media, then add:

substeps.instruction: 4 µL diluted electroporation enhancer (100 µM in IDTE)
10 µL RNP gRNA mix prepared in step 3

steps.title: Configure nucleofector device
steps.instruction: Turn on the nucleofector, install the X‑core, and select the program appropriate for the cell type (or the closest available program).

steps.title: Electroporate cell suspension
steps.instruction: Load the cell‑RNP suspension into the nucleofector cuvette, ensuring no air bubbles. Perform the electroporation, then keep the cuvette in the zap mixture for 10 seconds before removal.

steps.title: Recover cells in quenching plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the electroporated cells to a quenching plate and incubate for a minimum of 4–5 hours at 37 °C.

steps.title: Collect samples for sorting
steps.instruction: Take aliquots of the recovered cells for downstream sorting.
